description: Finish the first ten chapters, up to A Home Worth Keeping.
Find all ten of Agnes Rook's torn pages about the farm.
Face the Hollow when it knocks at your door like Elias.
Have the vote on the bell put again at the mill, and win it.
Find Davy Tull in the roots of the great tree before he goes.
Finish every story chapter.
Reach the ending The Hollow Sleeps.
Reach the ending Two Came Home.
Reach the ending The Line Under the Rooks.
Reach all three endings, in any of your saves.
Walk Old Maren to the edge of the Rookery Wood.
Take the dark trail at the fingerpost, and arrive.
Set out with a walker after 18:00, and arrive.
Walk Maren to the mill, Davy to the orchard, and the vicar and the postman to the chapel.
Find all five of Agnes's pages from the wood.
Walk the woman in grey to the Hollow's grove.
Walk the wood until its dread is at its height.
Walk someone past the wood's edge without giving them a ration or a loaf.
Take the dark trail by night, and arrive.
Live through your first night.
See the Hollow at the far edge of the field.
Hold the thing at the field's edge in your light until it thins away.
Hold the door shut while the latch rattles.
Drive the crows off your crops in the night.
Reach into the pond on the lights' third swell.
Face the tall figure watching from beside the house.
Outlast the footsteps behind you, indoors or in a lamp's light.
Hold the Hollow in your light at your own door until it comes apart.
Catch something at the coop or the barn in your own light.
Keep every hen and goat you have through a whole winter.
Grow crops through a whole season without the shadow blighting one.
Let your sanity fall under 20, and bring it back above 60.
Face fifty things that come in the night.
Earn four hearts with one of the walkers.
Bring a walker what they asked you for.
See Old Maren's last scene.
See Davy Tull's last scene.
See the vicar's last scene.
See the postman's last scene.
Earn ten hearts with Maren, Davy, the vicar and the postman.
Bring the walkers everything they ask for, every request.
Harvest your first crop.
Catch a fish.
Cook a meal at the fire.
Build a Tin Lantern.
Restore the farmhouse fully.
Build a Hollow Lantern.
Keep four hens and three goats at once.
Harvest every kind of crop.
Catch every kind of fish.
Cook every recipe at least once.
Build the cellar room, the covered porch and the second storey.
Pay off the land deed.
Reach level 10 in every skill.
Land a pale carp from the pond after 22:00.
Be out on your feet when the night takes you.
Wade a flooded hollow in winter with your walker on your back.
Follow the lights off the path, and come out where you meant to.
Leave something on the cairn of crow skulls.
Hold forty crow feathers at once.
